ads.headline: Lead gen intent down 67% YoY; shift focus to bottom-funnel conversions
actions: Switch $25/day budget to conversion campaigns targeting warm audiences only
Create service-specific landing pages (plumbing emergencies, gutter cleaning quotes) for direct booking
Test retargeting website visitors with service offers instead of broad lead-gen angles
ads.source: Google Trends data analysis; lead generation interest at 16 vs historical baseline

creative.headline: Instagram Reels dominates discovery—optimize for the algorithm NOW
actions: "I stopped charging by the hour and started charging THIS instead—plumbers are making 3x more."

Video idea: Screen record a simple pricing strategy comparison (hourly vs. service-based pricing). Show a plumber's before/after revenue. First line: "This one pricing change made plumbers $10K extra per month." Why it works: Service owners are desperate for revenue hacks, and Reels are the only format spiking in discoverability right now (95/100 on Google Trends).

Avoid: Overly technical Meta ads breakdowns. Engagement data shows zero interest in 'content hook' and 'facebook ads creative' as search terms—audiences want RESULTS and money talk, not strategy theory.
creative.source: Google Trends week data (Instagram Reels at 95/100 search interest spike)

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
